why: Analysis 2 matches the key more closely: its denominator is profit per local household, its top stop-doing item is the small conventional stores, and it names that store base as becoming obsolete, whereas Analysis 1 leads with the price war and manufacturing and puts the small-store decision fourth. Analysis 1 is slightly better calibrated, with a stated confidence level, an honest note that it cannot schedule the re-check and a caveat on the method, but Analysis 2 is the more useful document to hand the leader.
